crossRefs.note: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…
I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
(For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
translations.asv: Moses the servant of Jehovah and the children of Israel smote them: and Moses the servant of Jehovah gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
